newsitem.title: USA: Dana Corp expanding and relocating divisions.
newsitem.headline: Dana Corp expanding and relocating divisions.

text.p: Dana Corp, an engineering and automotive products maker, said Tuesday it is consolidating two of its engine products plants into one. The company said 60 workers will be affected, with about a third of them moving to a new location.

Dana said in a statement that it will relocate and consolidate its Perfect Circle operations, currently located in Richmond, Ind. into its Sealed Power facility found in Muskegon, Mich. The new and expanded division will be renamed Perfect Circle Sealed power. The move is expected to go into effect on Sept 1.

The company says that it anticipates being able to offer the roughly 40 workers staying behind in Richmond, positions in Dana's cylinder liner facility. That facility is being expanded when similar operations are moved from Rochester, Ind. to Richmond.
Dana said it currently employs 48,000 people worldwide and recorded revenues of $7.7 billion in 1996.
